text: omar: hey team — excited to join the product/design squad today! quick setup tries: 1) i can see top-level Figma files but the ‘Design Lab’ prototypes show Request Access 2) any onboarding reading for product strategy + research rituals? 3) where do i put notes from my discovery shadow sessions? tia: welcome @omar! design lab prototypes are gated — i just asked the lab owners to add you. can you share the email you used for SSO? omar: omar.k@redwood.ai tia: good — invite sent. after you accept, refresh the Figma file list and toggle Libraries. design-ops-bot: Hi Omar! Steps to resolve Figma access: 1) visit https://auth.redwood.com/sso and sign in 2) if still blocked, run `/ticket create "Figma SSO blocked"` and include your email. We'll auto-add you to `design:product` team once ticket is resolved. carol: for onboarding reading, start with Product -> Welcome -> 30-60-90 in Notion, then Product Rituals -> Weekly Sync & Research Playbook. link: https://notion.so/redwood/product-onboarding. those docs have the meeting cadence + handoffs. omar: perfect — linked the 30-day plan to my calendar. question re notes: should discovery notes go into the team roadmap doc or a personal notebook page? tia: we prefer discovery notes in Notion under Product -> Research -> Discovery Notes so they’re searchable and can be linked to roadmap items. add a header like: "Discovery / <topic> / <date>". people-ops: quick FYI re swag and stickers — ping us with your shipping address in DM and we'll send a welcome kit. also we assign a buddy for week 1; you should see a calendar invite from your buddy later today. omar: thanks! one process nit: prototype naming — i've seen both `proto/feature-v1` and `feature_proto_v1`. what's standard? tia: team standard is kebab-case and include team if cross-team: `proto/<team>-<feature>-v1`. example: `proto/payments-checkout-v1`. this helps search and tooling. design-ops-bot: Prototype naming rule added to the Design Handbook. Also added Omar to Research Calendar and Design Lab permissions. carol: if you plan moderated sessions, file a request in #research-scheduling at least 48 hours ahead for room & compensation processing. omar: noted — i have two shadow sessions tomorrow, i'll post times. thanks for the warm welcome everyone :tada:
